dataset_info.name: YojnaLens Maharashtra Government Schemes Dataset
dataset_info.purpose: Starter dataset for scheme discovery, eligibility screening, and document checklist generation.
dataset_info.important_notice: This is a starter dataset, not a complete official government database. Eligibility, benefit amounts, application windows, and document requirements can change by Government Resolution (GR), department, course, category, and academic year. Verify each scheme on its official portal before showing a user as eligible or advising them to apply.
data_quality_rules: Treat eligibility as a preliminary match, not a final government decision.
Do not invent income limits, benefit amounts, deadlines, or document requirements when they are not verified for the current scheme year.
Ask for only the personal details required to assess a scheme.
Do not store Aadhaar numbers, bank account numbers, or uploaded identity documents in this public scheme dataset.
Keep source URLs and last-verified dates for each scheme.

common_user_profile_fields.label: Person with benchmark disability / disability certificate
Living in hostel / paying guest / rented accommodation

document_catalog.label: Aadhaar or other accepted identity proof
document_catalog.note: Use only where requested by the application portal.

document_catalog.label: Maharashtra domicile certificate
document_catalog.note: Some schemes may accept an eligible parent’s domicile proof; verify the scheme rules.

document_catalog.label: Family income certificate
document_catalog.note: Issuing authority and financial year requirements vary by scheme.

document_catalog.label: Caste validity certificate
document_catalog.note: Required only for schemes/courses where the rules specify it.

document_catalog.label: Non-creamy layer certificate
document_catalog.note: Required only for applicable categories and schemes.

document_catalog.label: Current-year admission receipt
document_catalog.note: Keep the fee receipt and admission confirmation available.

document_catalog.label: CAP allotment/admission document
document_catalog.note: Required where the scheme requires CAP admission.

document_catalog.label: Bonafide student certificate
document_catalog.note: Usually issued by the educational institution.

document_catalog.label: Bank passbook / account proof
document_catalog.note: Bank account should meet the portal's DBT and Aadhaar-seeding requirements where applicable.

document_catalog.label: Hostel / PG / rent proof
document_catalog.note: Agreement or certificate may be required for private accommodation.

document_catalog.label: Attendance certificate
document_catalog.note: Required by some maintenance allowance schemes.

document_catalog.label: Family declaration / undertaking
document_catalog.note: Only where the scheme rules require it.

document_catalog.label: Education gap supporting document
document_catalog.note: Required only if there is an education gap and the scheme asks for proof.

schemes.name: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
schemes.description: Financial assistance for eligible Scheduled Caste students studying after matriculation, subject to the current scheme rules.

benefits.summary: Scholarship and eligible educational support as defined by the current Government Resolution.
benefits.amount_note: Do not display a fixed amount until verified against the current scheme rules and course.

additional_conditions_to_verify: Current family income ceiling and any course-specific conditions.
Whether the institution and course are approved for the scheme.
Whether the applicant is eligible for another scholarship or fee benefit.
Fresh or renewal application rules for the relevant academic year.
schemes.verification_status: scheme-listed; verify current GR and detailed eligibility before production use

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Government of India) for Scheduled Tribe Students
schemes.description: Financial assistance for eligible Scheduled Tribe students pursuing post-matric education, subject to current rules.

benefits.summary: Scholarship and eligible educational support as defined by the current scheme rules.
benefits.amount_note: Benefit varies by applicable rules, course, and approved fees.

additional_conditions_to_verify: Current family income ceiling.
Course and institution approval.
Fresh/renewal rules and any minimum academic requirements.
schemes.verification_status: scheme-listed; verify current GR and detailed eligibility before production use

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC / VJNT / SBC Students
schemes.description: Post-matric scholarship support for eligible students in applicable backward-class categories. Exact scheme mapping depends on the applicant's category and current portal listing.

benefits.summary: Scholarship and eligible fee/maintenance support as specified by the applicable scheme.
benefits.amount_note: Do not assume one benefit amount applies to every category or course.

additional_conditions_to_verify: Exact scheme for the applicant's subcategory.
Current income ceiling and non-creamy layer requirement, if applicable.
Course/institute eligibility, admission route, and renewal conditions.
schemes.verification_status: category grouping only; map to the exact current portal scheme before eligibility decisions

schemes.name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
schemes.description: Tuition-fee scholarship support for eligible students under the applicable higher-education rules. Eligibility differs by course, category, gender where specified, admission route, and academic year.

benefits.summary: Eligible tuition/examination fee support according to the current scheme rules.
benefits.amount_note: Percentage and fee coverage must be confirmed for the exact course and current academic year.

additional_conditions_to_verify: Current family income limit.
Eligible course, institution, and admission route.
Category-specific rules and any gender-specific provisions.
Whether another scholarship or fee reimbursement can be claimed simultaneously.
schemes.verification_status: scheme-listed; verify current GR and exact course/category conditions

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Persons with Disability
schemes.department: Applicable Maharashtra government department / MahaDBT listing
schemes.description: Educational scholarship support for eligible students with disabilities, subject to the current scheme's disability and course conditions.

benefits.summary: Scholarship and eligible educational support as specified by current rules.
benefits.amount_note: Confirm benefit components and disability criteria on the official scheme page.

additional_conditions_to_verify: Minimum disability percentage and accepted certificate format.
Current income and academic conditions, if specified.
Course and institution eligibility.
schemes.verification_status: scheme-listed; verify exact department and current conditions

schemes.name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
schemes.short_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance
schemes.department: Directorate of Higher Education / applicable course department
category: Eligible students under current scheme rules
schemes.description: Maintenance assistance for eligible students who meet the scheme's course, admission, domicile, income/occupation, and accommodation conditions.

benefits.summary: Maintenance allowance; amount depends on the applicable rules and location/course grouping.
benefits.amount_note: Do not hardcode an allowance amount without checking the applicable scheme page and Government Resolution.

additional_conditions_to_verify: Eligible course and admission route, including CAP where required.
Current family income and parent occupation/landholding conditions, where applicable.
Attendance, examination, family-beneficiary limits, and restrictions on receiving another maintenance allowance.
Accepted hostel, PG, or rental proof.
schemes.verification_status: scheme-listed; conditions vary by department/course, verify before use
